bearerAuth.description: Use the bearer token provided through the Neural4D website.

uuid.description: Unique job or model identifier returned by a previous create endpoint.

prompt.description: Text prompt used to generate the 3D model.

disablePbr.description: PBR toggle. Use `0` to enable PBR and `1` to disable it.

onlyGenerateMesh.description: Whether to generate only the mesh, without texture or PBR output.

mesh_quality.description: Mesh quality level. Supported values are standard, high, and extra_high.

faceNum.description: Target face count. standard accepts 100000 to 500000 and defaults to 500000; high and extra_high accept 500000 to 1000000 and default to 1000000.
Target face count for standard quality.

mesh_quality.description: High or extra-high mesh quality; this branch also applies when omitted.

faceNum.description: Target face count for high, extra-high, or default quality.

uuids.description: Generated UUIDs that can be used later to retrieve the models.

pointsDeducted.description: Credits deducted when the value is available.

generationConfig.description: Normalized face-count configuration applied to this generation request.

codeStatus.description: Result status. `0` means completed, `1` means generating, `-1` means the token is invalid or expired, `-2` means the UUID does not exist, and `-3` means generation failed.

modelUrl.description: Download URL for the generated model when available.

imageUrl.description: Preview image URL for the generated model when available.

prompts.description: Prompt content associated with the generated model.

sourcePage.description: Source page marker returned by the service.

disablePbr.description: PBR toggle. Use `0` to enable PBR and `1` to disable it.

success.description: Whether the generation request was accepted.

data.description: Queue and task details for the accepted generation request.

uuid.description: UUID of the generated model to convert.

scaleNumber.description: Returned scale number when the conversion finishes.

modelSize.description: Echoed model size from the request or intermediate response.

statusCode.description: Detection status. `0` means the result is valid and `-1` means the result is invalid.

result.description: Whether a human portrait was detected in the uploaded image.

statusType.description: Query status. `0` means the result is valid and `-1` means the result is invalid.

data.description: Current point balances grouped by point type.

total_points.description: Total points currently available to the account.

monthly_bonus_points.description: Available points granted by the monthly plan.

permanent_points.description: Available permanent points without a monthly expiration.

year_points.description: Available points granted by the annual plan.

expiration_day.description: Expiration day for time-limited points when present.

progress.description: Current job progress percentage returned by the service.

value.description: Normalized face count applied to the generation task.

faceNum.description: Face-count limits and the normalized value applied to the generation task.

value.description: Rejected request value when it is available.

location.description: Request location containing the invalid field.

error.description: Internal or downstream error description when available.
